g.title: Any HTTP, gRPC or MCP service, local or remote. WebSocket requests are skipped in a run.
The report package writes text, JSON, JUnit, HTML or Markdown, with pass or fail per request and per check. The exit code is 0 for pass, 1 for a failed check, 2 for bad usage and 3 for no response.

A Gostman folder read by the workspace package, a Postman or Bruno export, or an OpenAPI file, loaded into one runner.Collection. Folders are read by a bounded pool of readers sized from the CPU count.
runner/data.go parses the file into rows. Each row is one iteration with its own variables, so one collection tests many inputs.
Resolves folder filters, tags, --only, iterations and --parallel into an ordered list of executions before anything is sent.
Runs pre-request scripts with the Postman pm and Bruno bru APIs inside goja, with a time limit and a 512 MB memory watchdog. Each script gets a runtime no other script has touched.
session.transmit picks engine.Send for HTTP-style requests, rpc.Invoke for gRPC or mcpclient.Invoke for MCP. Cookies are kept per run.
Extract rules write variables for later requests. Post-response scripts and assertions then run, and checks that need no user code share one session runtime. OpenAPI contract checks run last.
